notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Illuminor Szeras.
You control an additional Zombie.
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {B}.
The ability granted by Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping Illuminor Szeras.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
